_comment_surface: R channel zeroed (was 0A1214). Rule: no red in a cyan palette, even near-black.
_comment_border: Was #1A3A40 dark teal — off-palette, forbidden. Now faint cyan hairline.
_comment_text: Was #E0F0F0 cyan-tinted white. Now neutral off-white (R=G=B). No cyan in body text.
_comment_text_dim: Was #6A8A8A grey-teal. Now neutral grey (R=G=B). No teal in secondary text.
_comment_danger_soft: Non-life-threatening trouble — low battery, offline, transport down. Distinct from danger (pure red = life-safety only).
_comment_info: Informational state — initialising, connecting, progress. Material blue, not cyan, so it reads as status not accent.
_comment_accent: Gold. Functional only (pinned notes, shield tier). NOT brand colour.
_comment_shield: Five shield tiers by lit-node count. Bronze (1) → Silver (2-8) → Gold (9) → Cyan (max). Cyan = brand colour worn only by users who maxed every node.
